title: Agricultural export subsidies
national_indicator_description: This indicator covers notifications of export subsidies applied by World Trade Organization (WTO) members pursuant to the provisions of article 9.4 of the Agreement on Agriculture.
computation_definitions: Agricultural export subsidies are defined as export subsidies budgetary outlays and quantities as notified by WTO Members in Tables ES:1 and supporting Tables ES:2 (following templates in document G/AG/2 dated 30 June 1995).
computation_calculations: Budgetary outlays and quantities are expressed in a currency (national or other) and in quantity units as per Member's notification practices.
other_info: Between 2001 and 2023, Rwanda has consistently notified that export subsidies were not granted to agricultural products.
comments_limitations: Notifications by WTO Members indicating the absence of use of export subsidies are not included in the indicator series. Therefore, no statistical indicator is provided for Rwanda.

page_content:
**Non-statistical indicator**

Between 2001 and 2023, Rwanda has consistently notified that export subsidies were not granted to agricultural products. 

Notifications by WTO Members indicating the absence of use of export subsidies are not included in the indicator series. Therefore, no statistical indicator is provided for Rwanda.
